parents.subject: Materials Science and Engineering
parents.course: Laboratory Studies in Materials Science and Engineering

ns2:section.sectionText: Experiments are performed on steel, a nickel-base superalloy, and bronze, processed by cold rolling and heat treatments. The course emphasizes the learning of physical metallurgy through experimentation (phase transformations, recrystallization, precipitation and other strengthening mechanisms), the proper use of instrumentation (metallography, tensile and hardness testing, x-ray diffraction, optical and scanning electron microscopy), communication skills, and respect for the importance of safety.
